description: RTE7000 French transmission grid topology, published by RTE France, documents the RTE7000 or RTE7K French transmission-network topology with approximately 7,000 nodes spanning 400 to 63 kV voltage levels. Coverage: The provider describes French node-breaker transmission-network snapshots at five-minute intervals from January 2021 to December 2023, distributed in annual repositories. Metadata and links are public on the provider-hosted Hugging Face dataset card; the underlying model files were not downloaded. The dataset card specifies CDLA-Permissive-2.0. Metadata access is free and ungated; no software-runtime licence is implied. Limitations: The old GitHub README points to a broken RTE700 address. A targeted provider metadata lookup found the current D-GITT-RTE7000 annual collection; the 2021 landing page is its common documentation. These topology snapshots omit injections and power flows, so they do not by themselves supply a solved operating state. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
